page.layout: One column of running text on one printed page. Running head at top, page number at top right. Signature "P 2" and catchword "filites" at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Domini sui, adeoque in eo funt attenti, ut verendum sit, ne nihil eorum quæ Dominus præceperit in adventu ejus, à strenuis hisce litigatoribus peractum deprehendatur; pugnantes enim, de ejus (ut sæpe contingit) in rebus minoribus voluntate, quæ ante cætera postulat, fidem & charitatem negligunt: sic quod olim in Pharisæos, hodie in illos competit, culicem excolantes camelum deglutiunt. Gravius autem ferent judicium, qui altercandi occasionem quam dederunt, fovent; ab ijs enim, corpus Christi, cujus commissuræ, vinculo Spiritus uniri debuerant, vesana rabie, opinionum varietate dilaniatur: quum (licet fratribus in quibusdam secus sentientibus) eadem regulâ, in illis quæ communia habemus salutis fundamentis, ad propositam spem contendendum foret: nam superbo ambitionis spiritu acti, dum nimis contendendo, alijs falsam (ut præ se ferunt) opinionem eripere conantur, veram ipsimet amaro incensi odio, & scientiam simul perdunt, & obedientiam: ita ubi tandem magnâ cum acerbitate victoriam obtinuerint, umbram tenent, corpus amiserunt. Nec sic erroribus omnibus ingressum dari in Ecclesiam quis calumnietur,

page.notes: Two dark ink blotches on the scan, one near "vinculo Spiritus" and one at the end of "amiserunt"; the words beneath are legible and copied as printed. Spellings kept as printed: "funt", "conantur", "alijs", "ipsimet". Long s was read as plain s throughout, including the opening "sui".
